code_corpus_baseline_random_auprc.principle: Equal to the positive base rate; any verifier with AUPRC at or below this value provides no information on this corpus.

code_status_energy_definition.1.0: extracted and syntax-valid candidate with runtime failure
code_status_energy_definition.note: Exp 2910 does not store a learned verifier-energy tensor; this audit uses only upstream per-candidate verifier/status fields and keeps sandbox pass/fail as the correctness label.

fover_corpus_auprc.principle: Recomputed from exp2837 for the apples-to-apples comparison the paper needs.

honest_verdict: complete: verifier provides meaningful information on code corpora
methodology_note: Computed average-precision AUPRC and threshold operating points without using AUROC. Code labels are Exp 2910 sandbox pass/fail outcomes. Code approval scores are derived only from Exp 2910 per-candidate extraction, syntax, and runtime-status fields because the artifact does not store a learned energy tensor. FoVer AUPRC uses raw Exp 2837 score rows and the same precision-recall implementation.

paper_v6_recommendation.principle: retain | narrow | retract for the code-corpus active-inference claim.

ppv_50_operating_point.principle: The threshold where verifier-approval has at least 50/50 odds of being correct. If unreachable, verifier is a hallucination multiplier on this corpus.
